worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.summary: Polish your body for temporary Speed and a smooth stopping glide. Both bonuses end with the polish; terrain stays unchanged.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.use.0: Stand and polish once before a fight to cap Speed
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.use.1: Use the visible shine window to force the opponent to stall
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.use.2: Run smoothly, with a short glide after stopping
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.description: Speed +%1$s level(s) after polishing; standing still to grind takes %2$s.
Polish lasts %1$s with a body slipperiness of %2$s: movement coasts briefly after release and still respects native collisions. Naturally more slippery terrain retains its own coefficient.
After a pass, it recovers for %1$s and starts a %2$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.grit.on: Fine polish takes longer to prepare and recover, but lasts longer, slides more and grants 3 Speed stages even to light bodies.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.grit.off: Coarse polish prepares and recharges faster but lasts less; bodies of at least 100 kg can gain 3 Speed stages.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.timing: Self move; after %1$s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, recovers for %2$s and starts a %4$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.growth.0: At level %1$s the shine extends to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.growth.1: At level %1$s the shine extends further to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
Coarse polish prepares and recharges faster. Fine polish takes longer, but lasts longer and slides more.
The companion considers polishing only when a threat is within this distance; larger means earlier preparation.
Below this distance the companion stops polishing and deals with the threat; larger gives up the boost more often up close.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.description: When the shine runs out or is cleared early (milk or a dispel), the Speed stages it raised are taken back at once; if Speed was near its cap so less was actually gained, only that much is removed.
